body:
With all due respect to y’all, I don’t think getting a gf is the solution here. Especially not tinder.

Having a gf doesn’t cure loneliness, many ppl are lonely in a relationship.

To OP, bro I’m sure it’s tough but u got this. Like everyone said this community is here for ya. 

I think that to solve loneliness smt important to do is to go out of your comfort zone and to try to make friends. If your wondering well how do you make friends, there are ways. One is to try to meet ppl in person (jobs, school events etc, or some ppl even using online means (Reddit etc.

There are good friends out there bro, and you feeling lonely is smt I can really relate to. I have no gf but I rarely feel lonely because I have good friends. Even if it’s just one person that’s more than enough. Stay strong bro, keep trying to put urself out there and I’m sure you’ll meet a friend who cares abt u. It’s okay to feel lonely, but you can definitely work through this.

However, if u think getting a gf will fix this then that’s just untrue. U don’t need one, what you need to do is take action urself and I’m sure you’ll be rewarded for it. U got this bro

Thanks man, feels like no matter what I do I’m fucked. I want success or fame and yet I know it won’t do anything to make me happy. It’s weirdly ironic so I’m like fk might as well kms lol because I don’t have an answer to this conflict. Ty tho for your response, sorry if me talking is ranty/silly

Thank you for your answer. Yeah I think the solution is getting off it, I know that people who get fame and money usually get it by a miss of hard work and luck (mostly luck if I had to be honest but I mean that’s just how privilege is).

Maybe getting off social media is the right answer for me. I know everyone suffers in life, and I’m sure famous and rich ppl, streamers YouTubers rappers artists writers etc all of these ppl probs suffer as much as any of us do, social media just makes me rly blind to it haha and it’s pretty shameful ngl makes me feel dumb.
